content:
Priya: Quick check — OrionHealth is ready for a combined launch: short case study blog + benchmark webinar. Target week of Apr 13. Can SE confirm benchmark numbers and runbook so we can lock messaging and embargo?
Dan: I can run the bench. Need exact model, sequence lengths, and a representative dataset. Also: do we disclose hardware (yes/no)? Ari, want me to include methodology in the blog appendix?
Ari: Drafting narrative now. Draft headline suggestion: 'How OrionHealth scaled inference while cutting unit cost' — flagged: avoid absolute multipliers until Dan uploads results. Mei will need to sign off on any percent/x claims.
Mei: Legal here — please don't use 'cut by' or assert % improvements without method + raw data. Send the CSV + scripts. Also we need explicit customer consent for quotes and to have an Orion speaker on the webinar.
Jules: I'll own outreach to the customer contact and ask for a speaker. Plan to ask for a short tech and a biz quote. Priya — do we want them to co-present or just be guest speakers?
Priya: Co-present preferred (2 Redwood + 1 Orion engineer, 1 Orion PM ideally). Ask for availability windows and remind them about embargo until publish time.
Jules: Sending outreach now. Draft message I will send: 
"Hi Sam — would you be interested in co-presenting a 30-min webinar with Redwood + being featured in a short case study? Proposed dates: Apr 15 or Apr 17. We’ll share benchmark methodology and draft slides for your review. We’d also ask for a brief quote and permission to publish on the agreed date (embargo until Apr 15 10:00 PT)."
Dan: Bench plan: 3 seeds, p95 latency, steady-state throughput at 8 concurrent streams. Model: Llama2-13b-q4. Hardware: a4 GPUs. Will run synthetic + small internal dataset. I'll upload CSV + the run script to Drive by Apr 3.
Ari: Blog excerpt for legal check: 
```
"With Redwood Inference, OrionHealth reduced per-request cost by 4.1x and improved median latency from 480ms to 190ms, enabling production-grade inference at scale."
```
Mei: Change language to 'OrionHealth reported a ~4.1x reduction in per-request cost and a median latency improvement from 480ms to 190ms.' Add a link to the methodology and raw data. Also prepare a short release/quote form for the customer to sign.
Rowan: I can run the webinar ops. Need final slide deck by Apr 8 and speaker bios. Will set calendar hold as soon as Sam confirms.
Priya: Action list for clarity: 
- Jules: customer outreach + speaker ask (today)
- Dan: run benchmarks + upload results (due Apr 3)
- Ari: finish blog draft + slides (due Apr 6)
- Mei: prepare release & quote form (due Apr 7)
- Rowan: set calendar + run webinar ops (on hold until confirmation)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your tasks.
calendar-bot: Event created: "OrionHealth Benchmark Webinar (tentative)" Apr 15 10:00 PT — https://calendar.example/evt/12345
Jules: Sent initial message to Sam at 09:13. He replied: "interested, need internal approvals, likely 2-3 business days." I asked for their preferred window and a contact for legal signoff.
Priya: Thanks — updating timeline. If approvals take >3 days, push publish to Apr 22 to avoid conflicts.
Dan: Uploaded results: https://drive.example/orion-orig/bench-results.csv and methodology: https://drive.example/orion-orig/methodology.md. Ran three seeds, attached raw logs.
Mei: Reviewed datasets. Need to redact one client-identifying metric in row 47 before publishing. Jules — pls confirm with Sam we can remove that line or anonymize.
Jules: Noted. Reaching back to Sam now to confirm redaction is okay and to request signed release.
Ari: Pushed blog + slide draft to Google: https://docs.google/orion-draft — added quote placeholder: "Sam, VP Product: 'Redwood helped us...'"
Priya: Once we have the signed quote + confirmation on redactions, I'll queue the blog and the webinar registration page. Good progress — thanks team.
Jules: Sam replied: "We can anonymize the metric. We'll review the release form and aim to confirm by EOD Fri."
Dan: Small note on methodology: include exact batch sizes and KV-cache warmup steps in appendix. That will make the multiplier reproducible.
Mei: I'll prepare a short customer release + quote form and an internal redline. Sending to Jules in 30m.
Rowan: I'll draft the run-of-show for the 30-min session: 3-min intros, 12-min benchmark walkthrough, 10-min customer talk, 5-min live Q&A. Will share by Apr 6.
Priya: Perfect. If anything blocks approvals, flag here so we can escalate to CSM. :pray:
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up with Sam on Apr 4 09:00 PT.
